info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Knowledge Asset Knowledge Exchange-spec
info.description: The Knowledge Asset Creation API enables users to create and manage knowledge assets within the banking system. This API provides a streamlined way for organizations to develop, submit, and integrate knowledge resources into their knowledge exchange framework. Typical consumers include developers working on banking applications, knowledge management teams, and innovators seeking to enhance informational assets. With robust functionality, this endpoint supports organizations in leveraging knowledge to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint facilitates the exchange of knowledge assets between parties, allowing users to share, retrieve, or manage valuable information efficiently.
